en: Add the payment milestones on Milestones. Each one shows its payment value and the date the money should arrive.
mt: 在 Milestones 上添加付款里程碑。每一项都显示其付款价值和款项应到达的日期。

en: Log each delay on Delays and each claim on Extension Claims. The cost of a day comes from the contract value and the claim position shows what you can ask from the client.
mt: 将每个延迟记录在“Delays”上，将每个付款索赔记录在“延期付款索赔”上。一天的费用来自合同价值，付款索赔位置显示您可以向客户要求什么。
